set.body:
Formal plan:
1. Make fit preparation explicit and typed so chunk execution cannot silently recompute global statistical state per voxel chunk.
2. Preserve the existing public FitPlanExecutor ergonomics while routing chunked execution through immutable prepared context.
3. Prove chunked fixed-AR GLS equals unchunked GLS on JVM and JS.
4. For estimated-AR GLS, either share one whole-selection whitening plan across chunks or reject chunking with a typed error until that law is implemented.
5. Keep shared code scheduler-neutral: local sequential and Future interpreters are allowed; Spark or cluster adapters belong later behind JVM-only interpreters.
6. Follow-on: define a scheduler-neutral chunk stream/interpreter boundary for local, Future, and eventual distributed runtimes.
set.title: Epic: chunk-safe fit execution
